mapper.insert: insert into tb_push_record (announcement_id, target_user_id, is_read, create_time) values (#{announcementId}, #{targetUserId}, #{isRead}, sysdate())

insert into tb_push_record (announcement_id, target_user_id, is_read, create_time) values
(#{item.announcementId}, #{item.targetUserId}, #{item.isRead}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select pr.id, pr.announcement_id, pr.target_user_id, pr.is_read, pr.read_time, pr.deleted, pr.create_time, pr.update_time, a.title as announcement_title from tb_push_record pr left join tb_announcement a on pr.announcement_id = a.id and a.deleted = 0 where pr.target_user_id = #{userId} and pr.deleted = 0 order by pr.create_time desc
mapper.update: update tb_push_record set is_read = #{isRead}, read_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from tb_push_record where target_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0 and deleted = 0
